entries.description: • Root records missing child backups are now skipped, allowing uninterrupted archiving of other records.

entries.title: Veeam Data Cloud introduces global ‘Org Dashboard’ and ‘Activity’ views to the Unified Experience
entries.description:
What’s New
Veeam Data Cloud now includes two new top-level views within the unified interface: the Org Dashboard and the Activity view. These additions provide administrators with comprehensive, role-based visibility into protection status, backup history, and platform activity across multiple workloads.
Org Dashboard:
• Offers a centralized overview of protection status and backup history across supported workloads, currently including Microsoft Entra ID and Salesforce.
• Displays the number of protected objects per workload, with breakdowns by object type.
• Highlights the last 7 days of backup activity, segmented by object protection and session status.
• Includes filter controls for quick review and investigation by workload.
• Access is RBAC-controlled, limited to organization and workload administrator roles (with support for custom roles).
Activity View:
• Unifies monitoring of protection activity, configuration changes, and access events across Microsoft Entra ID, Salesforce, and general Veeam Data Cloud system events.
• Details completed and in-progress backup sessions, as well as audit logs for logins, user and tenant creation, and role changes.
• Access is also RBAC-controlled and available to organization and workload administrator roles, with custom role support.
Why This Matters
These new global views simplify oversight for administrators, making it easier to monitor data protection coverage, backup activity, and platform events across multiple workloads. Centralized dashboards and filtering enable more efficient investigation, monitoring, and auditing – supporting operational efficiency, compliance, and improved security across the organization.
What’s Next
Both views will see ongoing improvements to further enhance oversight and usability. Planned updates for the Org Dashboard include adding restore history, expanding time filter options, and supporting additional workloads. For the Activity view, upcoming enhancements will introduce export capabilities as well as expanded tracking for protection management, data access, and restore events. These updates are designed to provide administrators with deeper insights and more unified management across the Veeam Data Cloud platform.
Learn More
Explore the user guide in the Help Center for detailed information about the organization dashboard, activity view and audit logs.

entries.title: Designed for Greater Control, Clarity, and Continuity
entries.description:
• Added support for restoring public libraries and Content Documents stored within them.
• Archival policy now switches to individual record processing on Salesforce “unknown exception” and skips already deleted records, ensuring archiving completes with minimal manual intervention.
• In-product notifications for restore jobs are now enabled by default, so users stay informed about restore progress and outcomes.
• Added support for Salesforce API version 63.0 to maintain compatibility with the latest platform features.
• “Manage Prompt Permissions” and “View and Edit Converted Leads” are now automatically included for organisations using Prompt Builder and users are notified if permissions are missing, reducing setup errors.
• Added masking rule for “Phone” fields to generate numeric values without regional formatting during sandbox seeding, supporting standardized test data.
• Alternative key case sensitivity now matches the source field. Non-unique “DeveloperName” values for “RecordType” are supported, reducing restore errors.
• Restoring inline images in rich-text fields is now supported, preserving content formatting.

entries.title: Support for new Salesforce Security Requirements in Connected App Authorization
entries.description:
• In alignment with Salesforce’s updated security measures effective September 2025, the connected app used for external authorization is required to be installed directly on the target Salesforce organization.
• The wizards for adding and re-authorizing Salesforce tenants have been enhanced to automatically verify the installation status of the required connected app. If the connected app is not installed, clear guidance and information are provided to help users complete the installation, ensuring a smooth onboarding and backup process.

entries.title: Improved Notification Emails and Tenant Provisioning Issue Managment
entries.description:
• The notification email template has been refreshed for improved clarity.
• Users can now view and address Salesforce tenant provisioning issues directly, including which IP addresses need to be whitelisted for successful integration.

entries.title: Updates to Smart Backup Policy Options and Restoration Options
entries.description:
• Smart backup policy now offers to automatically configure required Salesforce permissions for the user running the backup.
• History objects are now excluded from backup policy by default, users can modify this setting to include them if needed.
• Supports logic to resotre activated contracts and orders, as well as work with inactive business hours records.

entries.title: Automatic Scheduling for Large Objects in Smart Backup Policy
entries.description: • Smart backup policy now automatically creates dedicated backup schedules for objects with more than 10 million records, helping achieve lower recovery point objectives (RPO).

entries.title: Launching Unified User Experience with Veeam Data Cloud for Entra ID and Veeam Data Cloud for Salesforce
entries.description:
We are excited to announce the launch of Veeam Data Cloud for Microsoft Entra ID and Veeam Data Cloud for Salesforce within the new unified Veeam Data Cloud interface. Organizations can now protect their Salesforce and Entra ID data using a modern, centralized platform that delivers secure, effortless backup and recovery as a fully managed SaaS service.
What’s New
This launch brings Salesforce and Entra ID protection together for the first time in a unified experience. Veeam Data Cloud for Salesforce helps organizations safeguard critical CRM data, metadata, and files, while Veeam Data Cloud for Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure Active Directory) delivers enterprise-grade protection and fast recovery for identity and access management data. Both solutions offer automated, policy-driven backup, flexible and granular recovery, and simplified subscription management — all accessible through a single, intuitive interface.
Looking Ahead
This is just the beginning for the unified Veeam Data Cloud platform. Existing Veeam Data Cloud products—including Microsoft 365, Microsoft Azure, and Vault—will soon be integrated into this interface, further expanding your ability to manage and protect multiple workloads from one place.
Getting Started
To learn more about Veeam Data Cloud for Salesforce or Microsoft Entra ID within the new unified interface, or to get started, please contact our sales team for more information.

entries.title: Now Standard: IAM Role-Based Authentication for AWS Vaults
entries.description:
IAM role-based Integrated Authentication is now the standard connection method for AWS Vaults.
• New and non-shared-key customers – AWS Access Key and Secret Key are hidden in the Customer Portal and can't be retrieved via the API.
• Existing shared key customers – Unaffected; no change to current access.
• Enabled per organization – Contact your Veeam account manager or Veeam Support to have it applied.

entries.title: Vault Assignment Confirmation (VBR v12 → v13)
entries.description:
Fixed an issue where assigning a vault from Veeam Backup & Replication v12 to an installation registered by v13 displayed an incorrect confirmation message and a duplicate application registration ID.
• Correct confirmation message now displays.
• Duplicate registration ID resolved – only one registration ID is shown.

entries.title: Storage Vaults & Manage Vaults pages
entries.description:
We've refreshed the Storage Vaults and Manage Vaults pages with improved navigation and at-a-glance visibility.
• New list view – Available alongside the existing layout, with sorting by Vault name or Used capacity (highest-first by default), and filtering by status.
• Consolidated actions – Assignments, Edit, and Delete are now combined into a single Manage button, available when a vault is Active.
• Subscription strip – See Edition, Cloud, and Capacity at a glance.

entries.title: Notification Emails for Deletion Lifecycle
entries.description:
Vault now sends email notifications at each stage of the deletion process, giving you better visibility into when data is scheduled for removal:
• Deletion initiated – Sent as soon as a deletion request is submitted.
• Deletion warning – Sent 5 days before the scheduled deletion, giving you a final window to cancel or intervene if needed.
• Deletion confirmed – Sent once the deletion has completed.

entries.title: New: Veeam Vault Archive
entries.description:
Veeam now offers Vault Archive, a new archival-class cloud tier for secure, compliant, long-term backup retention at lower cost than premium storage.
With Vault Archive, you can:
• Retire ROT data – Move redundant, obsolete, and trivial backup data off premium storage into archive-class cloud storage.
• Strengthen security & compliance – Data is immutable, encrypted, and logically air-gapped, with user-defined placement to support long-term regulatory needs.
• Simplify governance – Tier data automatically from Veeam Data Cloud Vault to Vault Archive via policy.
• Replace tape – Get a fully managed cloud archive that's secure by default and accessible on demand.

entries.title: Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) for Azure Vault editions
entries.description:
Veeam Data Cloud Vaults deployed on Azure now support BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) encryption for greater control over the encryption of your backup data. With BYOK encryption, you host and manage your own encryption keys in Microsoft Azure Key Vault. Veeam Data Cloud uses your key to encrypt backup data, but never stores it, and you can revoke access at any time.
Keeping keys in your own Azure Key Vault helps satisfy regulatory and internal security requirements (e.g., data sovereignty, separation of duties) that mandate the customer to retain custodianship of encryption keys.
This feature is available on request. To enable encryption key management in your Veeam Data Cloud organization, contact Veeam Customer Support.

entries.title: Private Endpoint Connectivity for Vaults
entries.description: • Support for Azure Private Link is now available for Azure Vault. This enables connections over a private network, reducing exposure to the public internet. For configuration details, refer to the setup guide on creating private endpoints.

entries.title: New Egress Usage Widgets and Graphs Added
entries.description:
• Added a per Vault egress usage widget and graph to the storage account details, providing granular insight into egress consumption by individual Vault.
• Added an aggregated egress usage widget and graph to the dashboard for a unified view of total egress activity.

entries.title: Region List Display Improved
entries.description: • Resolved an issue where the region column in the tenant listing would cut off the region list if too many regions were present. Veeam Data Cloud now displays an ellipsis, and selecting it reveals the full list of regions.

entries.title: Vault Provisioning and Wizard Navigation Issues Resolved
entries.description:
• Resolved an issue that prevented users with organization names containing special characters from provisioning workload tenants.
• Fixed the Add Vault wizard so the back button now functions correctly.

entries.title: Self-Service Vault Deletion and Read-Only Viewer Role Added
entries.description:
• Added self-service deletion for empty vaults in Veeam Data Cloud, supporting both Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services vaults. Users can now quickly remove empty vaults without contacting support.
• Introduced the Vault:Viewer role, providing read-only access so administrators can grant users permission to view vaults and tenants without allowing creation, modification, or deletion of resources.

entries.title: Vault Registration Streamlined
entries.description: • Vault registration has been updated to allow direct assignment of a Vault to a registered Veeam product (such as Veeam Backup & Replication or Kasten) within Veeam Data Cloud. Switching to My Account for Vault assignment is no longer required, streamlining the setup process for administrators.

entries.title: Usability Updates for Storage Management and AWS Vaults
entries.description:
• Pagination and search functionality have been introduced for storage vaults, making it easier to browse and manage large numbers of vaults. Vaults are now organized into pages, and the search feature allows quick location by Storage Display Name or Vault ID.
• The Vault ID for AWS Vaults is now generated and displayed during AWS S3 bucket creation, making it easier to add the Vault to VBR. The Vault ID can be copied directly from the credentials configuration, eliminating the need to navigate to the created vault.

entries.title: Veeam Data Cloud Vault for AWS Added to Unified Web Interface
entries.description:
Whats New
We're excited to share that Veeam Data Cloud Vault for AWS is now part of the unified Veeam Data Cloud experience. Previously unavailable, this added cloud storage support for AWS expands our breadth of regional availability while meeting our customers where they are.
Why this Matters
Adding Vault for AWS to the Veeam Data Cloud product family, adds another key piece of cross-cloud coverage, fulfilling the goal of one platform / any workload. Vault gives organizations a consistent, centralized view across backup and storage, making it easier to ensure data resilience and compliance for all workloads.
Getting Started
To learn more about Veeam Data Cloud Vault within the unified web interface visit the product page, or for information on how to purchase visit this page.

entries.title: Veeam Data Cloud Vault Joins the Unified Experience
entries.description:
Veeam Data Cloud Vault is now available within the unified web interface alongside Veeam Data Cloud for Microsoft 365, Veeam Data Cloud for Entra ID and Veeam Data Cloud for Salesforce. This update brings secure, immutable cloud storage together with your SaaS backup and recovery management in a single, streamlined platform.
What’s New
• Unified Web Interface: Manage your Vault storage and monitor consumption alongside your other protected workloads, all from one centralized location.
• Simplified Management: Easily view storage usage, retention, and billing details for Vault, with seamless integration into the broader Veeam Data Cloud experience.
Why This Matters
Adding Vault to the unified interface gives organizations a consistent, centralized view across backup and storage, making it easier to ensure data resilience and compliance for all workloads.
Transition to Unified Experience
All existing Veeam Data Cloud Vault users will be seamlessly transitioned to the unified experience — no action is required.
Getting Started
To learn more about Veeam Data Cloud Vault within the unified web interface visit the product page, or for information on how to purchase visit this page.
